finite_copy_deterministic_bound.statement: epsilon_t >= 1-exp[-2t(mu-kappa)^2/(N-1)^2]-exp[ln M_t-t(m kappa-ln Z_N)] for N>1, 1<=kappa<mu; N=1 has epsilon_t>=1-M_t/D^t

strong_converse.threshold: m mu-ln Z_N, the EXISTING stopping threshold
strong_converse.does_not_claim: strong converse at the unknown full generic entanglement cost

uniform_diagonal_leading_law.statement: For fixed J,d, arbitrary delta_t->0 and t->infinity, deterministic supplied rate below (1-xi)J ln d/(2delta_t) forces global error to1; the ordinary stock construction attains leading1/2 with error1/t
uniform_diagonal_leading_law.limit_justification: directly from finite-t finite-N inequalities, not exchange of old asymptotic limits

expected_supplied_resource_extension.definition: preselect a classical branch before receiving Bell rank M_r; charge E ln M_r; branches averaged and genuinely erased if not retained; GLOBAL iid preparation error tolerance epsilon
expected_supplied_resource_extension.leading_optimum: (1-epsilon)J ln d/(2delta), at fixed epsilon in[0,1)
expected_supplied_resource_extension.warning: This is not deterministic E_C^op and not the old exact preselected factory definition when epsilon>0; fixed-delta logarithmic gap remains

genuine_gamble_counterexample.statement: With good probability q supply Phi_(D^t), otherwise supply rank1 and output chi_D^tensor t; erased-coin output error=(1-q)(1-D^-t), expected resource=q t ln D
genuine_gamble_counterexample.consequence: deterministic-resource strong converse cannot extend to mean supplied resource at nonzero global error
